verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships a local OpenAI-compatible server (`edge0 serve`), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a maximum number of concurrent requests or connections, or when throughput degrades. The +59% decode throughput figure and the bench script concern single-stream decode speed, not concurrency limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the documented maximum concurrent requests or connections the local server can handle before throughput degrades
